name: Ragi Chips Chatpata Crunch
ingredients_raw: Ragi flour, tapioca starch, rice flour, white lentil flour, gram flour, iodised salt, edible vegetable oil (sunflower oil) Seasoning: Dehydrated vegetable powder (tomato, garlic, lemon & onion), dry mango powder, ginger powder, clove powder, dextrose, glucose powder, anti-caking agent (INS 551), sugar, maltodextrin, acidity regulator (INS 330, INS 296), flavour enhancer (INS 635), paprika oleoresin (INS 160c), cumin powder, fennel powder, coriander powder, yeast extract powder.
